companionOf.description: Name/slug of an existing app this one is a companion of (e.g. a preview or staging environment, or an A/B variant). The new app reuses the parent's repo and joins a shared project so the two show up stacked, while staying its own separate deployment. Pair with a different branch for a prod/preview split.
